name: sdd
description: A spec-driven workflow with lightweight milestone memory: /milestone clarifies the intended outcome, tracks work not yet represented by an epic, and optionally syncs progress read-only from Beads; /specify authors stories/epics, /refine revises them, /board renders the backlog, /solve implements one in an isolated worktree, /validate merges after human review, and /orchestrate automates a whole epic behind one final PR. Requires the bd CLI for the story workflow and milestone sync.
